dreamledger_stripe_webhook_v3.finding: Deployed Supabase function exists but has no matching source path on current main.

canonical_revenue_endpoint.finding: This is the enabled canonical revenue endpoint. It durably inserts stripe_webhook_events before downstream work, but still performs downstream commerce inline before acknowledgement.

inbox.queue_path: stripe_webhook_events INSERT -> AFTER INSERT trigger -> settlement_enqueue_webhook -> processed_webhook_events

critical_findings: dreamledger-stripe-webhook-v3 is not the live Stripe production endpoint identified from the connected Stripe account.
dreamledger-stripe-webhook-v3 writes its stripe_webhook_events receipt only after CUBE reconciliation work, so it is not a durable intake boundary.
stripe-revenue is the enabled canonical revenue endpoint and writes stripe_webhook_events before downstream processing, but remains a synchronous processor.
The existing processed_webhook_events queue already supplies durable lease/claim infrastructure. Creating another competing queue is unnecessary.
The existing settlement consumer covers marketplace settlement but not the complete stripe-revenue downstream path.
consumer_gap: The full stripe-revenue path additionally creates or reconciles revenue_orders, event_ledger, revenue_entitlements, fulfillment_requests, economic_events and control_reconciliations. Those operations need an owned worker path before the canonical webhook can safely become enqueue-and-ack.

economic_model_task_trace.exact_failure_point: Cloud-connected tooling cannot execute the user's Windows/LM Studio process; repository and database trace can establish the consumer and claim path but not a local inference run.
